title: Backscatter Radar Target
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Backscatter_Radar_Target.md
text: 后向散射雷达目标，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Azimuth angles (deg)} 指定方位角；{Elevation angles (deg)} 指定俯仰角、{RCS pattern (m^2)} 指定雷达截面积方向图 ones、{Fluctuation model} 指定目标起伏模型、{Propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Operating frequency (Hz)} 指定工作频率 3e8、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 窄带信号 N -by- 1 complex-valued vector | N -by- M complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 入射信号方向 2-by-1 real-valued column vector | 2-by- M real-valued column matrix

ports.name: Update
ports.summary: 用于更新 RCS 的开关 false | true

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 窄带反射信号 1-by- M complex-valued vector | N -by- M complex-valued matrix

params.name: Azimuth angles (deg)
params.values: 方位角 [-180:180] (default) | 1-by- P real-valued row vector | P -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Elevation angles (deg)
params.values: 俯仰角 [-90:90] (default) | 1-by- Q real-valued row vector | Q -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: RCS pattern (m^2)
params.values: 雷达截面积方向图 ones(181,361) (default) | Q -by- P real-valued matrix | Q -by- P -by- M real-valued array | 1-by- P real-valued vector | M -by- P real-valued matrix

params.name: Fluctuation model
params.values: 目标起伏模型 Nonfluctuating (default) | Swerling1 | Swerling2 | Swerling3 | Swerling4

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
